title: Efficacy of Combined Oral L-ornithine-L-aspartate and Lactulose in Patients With Hepatic Encephalopathy
brief_summary: Hypothesis: Is the combination of oral L-ornithine-L-aspartate and lactulose more efficacious than oral lactulose alone in treatment of hepatic encephalopathy? Study design; Randomized, double-blinded, placebo controlled trial
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cirrhosis
* Age 18-80
* Hepatic encephalopathy grade II-III
* Serum ammonia \> 60 mcg/mL
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recent GI hemorrhage
* Severe sepsis
* Degenerative CNS disease or major psychiatric illness
* Serum creatinine \> 1.5 mg/dl
* Pregnancy or lactation
* Poorly controlled DM
* Insertion of TIPS
* Received CNS depressants or hypnotics
* Treatment with metronidazole, kanamycin or branched-chain amino acid
* Hypersensitivity to L-ornithine-L-aspartate
